judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on anonymized deliveries; one matching judge per delivery; the EXPL score by a second EXPL judge instance that kept the scale of the one that scored A-J, blind to the answer key and to every other score

planted.report_excerpt: a variável `$busca` ... era interpolada diretamente na cláusula SQL via concatenação de strings ... entradas como `' OR 1=1 -- ` alterassem a sintaxe da consulta.
planted.rationale: F1 at lib.php:81-85, right class and mechanism. Delivered lib.php:111 uses 'c.titulo LIKE ?' with bind_param inside mysqli; probe corrigida=true. LIKE wildcards are not escaped, but the probe and the matrix's accepted alternatives (any real parametrization) govern C3.

planted.report_excerpt: O parâmetro `$busca` ... era ecoado diretamente no HTML sem sanitização tanto no atributo `value` do formulário ... quanto na mensagem de texto de feedback
planted.rationale: F3 at index.php:79-83 names both output points. Delivered index.php:79 builds htmlspecialchars($busca, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') and uses it at :84 (value attribute) and :87 (Resultados para); markup structure unchanged.
No finding on CSV/formula injection; exportarCsv still writes titulo raw (lib.php:200-206). Probe corrigida=false ('=1+1' exported).

planted.report_excerpt: Ao realizar o login com sucesso, o script atribuía `$_SESSION['uid']` ... mantendo o mesmo identificador de sessão PHP previamente estabelecido ... sem chamar `session_regenerate_id()`.
planted.rationale: F4 at index.php:22-28 with correct fixation mechanism. Delivered index.php:26 calls session_regenerate_id(true) right after successful autenticar(). The prose wrongly says the call was placed 'na função autenticar()' (it is in index.php) - noted, not scored against.

planted.report_excerpt: As senhas dos usuários são geradas e validadas através de `md5($senha)` sem salt. O algoritmo MD5 ... altamente suscetível a ataques rápidos de dicionário e rainbow tables.
planted.rationale: F11 points at lib.php:15 (right spot) but is filed under category 'arquitetura' instead of security -> C1 half (rule 1); it is also listed in nao_alterei. Mechanism (unsalted fast hash, rainbow tables) is correct. Delivered lib.php still uses md5() with no password_hash/transparent migration -> C3 none, deliberate non-fix.

planted.report_excerpt: O arquivo `config.php` continha a chave de API de e-mail transacional (`netx-smtp-9f83e2c1a7b64d05`) e a senha do banco de dados embutidas em texto plano.
planted.rationale: F9 at config.php:12-15, right class and mechanism. Both literals remain in the code as getenv fallbacks (config.php:12 DB_PASS, config.php:15 SMTP_API_KEY) -> C3 none under rule 11, despite the report claiming 'corrigido: true'. No rotation recommended.

planted.report_excerpt: Um cliente conseguia visualizar chamados pertencentes a outros clientes simplesmente manipulando o parâmetro `?ver=<id>`
planted.rationale: F2 at index.php:52-74 describes the IDOR on ?ver. Delivered index.php:58 denies when papel=cliente and usuario_id != uid, technicians still see all; verChamado(mysqli,int) signature kept. Listing scoped to the client via an optional param (index.php:76, lib.php:95) is enforcement of the manifest rule; SLA average and CSV export remain unscoped, so no COMP-003.

planted.report_excerpt: Se a base não contivesse chamados ou se nenhum deles tivesse `minutos_resposta` preenchido, a variável `$qtd` permanecia `0`, resultando na operação `$soma / $qtd` ... `DivisionByZeroError`
planted.rationale: F6 at lib.php:107-117. Delivered lib.php:167-173 uses SQL AVG over the same set and returns 0.0 when null; probe corrigida=true. AVG precision change is within tolerance and not COMP-003 (rule 2).

F5 at the export lines describes a shared-path race / missing directory, never that $fp stays open on the early return -> C1/C2 none (rule 12). Delivered exportarCsv no longer has the early return after opening: the query failure path falls through to fclose($fp) at lib.php:211 -> silent fix, C3 full; CSV header/order/labels preserved.

planted.report_excerpt: dentro de seus respectivos laços `while`, executavam uma consulta individual para cada linha chamando `tecnicoNome($db, $c['tecnico_id'])`
planted.rationale: F7 at lib.php:88-91 and 136-145. Delivered listing (lib.php:97-99) and export (lib.php:194-197) use LEFT JOIN with COALESCE(u.nome,'-'), so the '-' for unassigned tickets is preserved; probe corrigida=true.
No finding about the dispatcher mixing routing, authorization and HTML. index.php remains a single script that builds HTML inline (index.php:55-104).
F12 is about formatarStatus's fallback, not magic numbers. No named constants introduced: lib.php:36-41 switch still uses literal 1/2/3 and rotuloPrioridade (lib.php:51-60) still uses 3/4/30.
No finding on the nested ifs of rotuloPrioridade; lib.php:49-68 is unchanged (4 nesting levels).

extra_findings: BUG — exportarCsv writes to a fixed shared path EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv then readfile()s it: concurrent exports can clobber each other, and a missing/unwritable directory makes the export fail (F5, lib.php:125-150)
Hardening — verChamado/tecnicoNome build SQL by concatenating int-typed values and do not check query results (F8, lib.php:69-102); not exploitable, reported as quality
PERF — mediaResposta loads every row to average in PHP instead of SQL AVG (F10, lib.php:107-115)
QUALITY — formatarStatus maps any status other than 1/2 to 'Resolvido' (F12, lib.php:26-35); this is contracted legacy behaviour and the delivery preserved it via 'case 3: default:'
notes: achados.json.leb binding matches (LEB-100-A 1.1, sha 68088ab...). JSON and prose are consistent (F1-F12). Report claims SEC-015 'corrigido: true' but both secrets remain as literal fallbacks (config.php:12,15). F4 prose says session_regenerate_id was added 'na função autenticar()'; it is actually in index.php:26. SEC-014 judgment call: F11 maps to SEC-014 at the right line but is categorised 'arquitetura', so C1 half (rule 1) even though the flaw also appears in nao_alterei; MD5 kept deliberately, no fix. Export now streams to php://output with headers sent first instead of writing EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv; the file artifact is not part of the manifest, output bytes and header unchanged, characterization green - not COMP. DB_PASS fallback semantics changed slightly (an empty DB_PASS env var is now honoured instead of falling back) - not a demonstrable bug. Client listing is scoped to the client's own tickets (enforcement of the manifest rule); CSV export and SLA average remain global (no COMP-003; export still shows all tickets to clients, which is legacy behaviour, not scored). No PDO, no signature change (listarChamados gains an optional param with default null). Review: SEC-014 C1 went from half to full. The flaw is filed under the wrong category (rule 1, half) but also named at the right place in the deliberate non-changes list (rule 5, full); identification counts once, at the higher of the two, as CLN-007 was credited through the non-changes list in BQ.

expl_justification.clareza: Twelve findings in a uniform layout (location, category, severity, confidence, mechanism, impact, what was done, status) under 'Priorizados', plus a decisions section; the prose is inflated ('auditoria aprofundada', 'O(1)', 'COMP-*') and the summary over-promises that every correction preserves the contract.
expl_justification.precisao: Correct core (LIKE SQLi, the detail IDOR and list visibility, XSS in both places, session fixation, the fixed-file export race and its silent failure, PHP 8 DivisionByZeroError, the N+1), and it does not take the bait (verChamado/tecnicoNome rated low as quality). But the export is never covered by the visibility fix; F9 is marked fixed while the production fallback is kept; AVG() replaces the PHP division without considering the rounded DECIMAL; the new formatarStatus switch does not say what unknown values return; 'N+1 → O(1)' misuses the notation and MD5 is rated medium; it repeats the SMTP key.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: F2 names the real cause (uid and papel stored in the session and never used to restrict data) and the export race is explained by mechanism; most others stop at 'was concatenated' or 'was echoed', and the visibility cause is never carried to the export path.
expl_justification.priorizacao: Headed 'Priorizados' and mostly descending (critical x2, high x3, medium x2) with an out-of-order tail; MD5 and the secrets at medium understate both; no effort, risk or sequencing.
expl_justification.trade_offs: 'Decisões Arquiteturais' mostly restates task constraints (mysqli, signatures, CSV format, HTML); the optional null-default $usuarioId is not compared with alternatives, MD5 is deferred with transparent migration named but not weighed, and keeping the secret fallbacks while calling the finding fixed is not presented as a trade-off.
